description:
Connection Storm Detector — WARN0307

Monitors the processlist for connection saturation:

1. Sleep ratio: fires when sleeping/total >= sleep-ratio-threshold (default 60%)
2. Lock waits: fires when threads stuck in lock-wait states >= lock-wait-count (default 3)

Skips evaluation when total connections < min-connections (default 10).

config_keys.label: Sleep ratio threshold
config_keys.help: Fraction of total connections that must be in Sleep state to fire. Formula: sleeping / total >= threshold.

config_keys.label: Lock-wait thread count
config_keys.help: Number of threads simultaneously waiting on a lock to fire.

config_keys.label: Min connections to evaluate
config_keys.help: Skip evaluation entirely when total active connections are below this value.
